items.title: Optimize AI Costs with New Relic Cloud Cost Intelligence on AWS
items.summary: Managing AI costs is a top challenge for organizations scaling generative AI on AWS. This post shows how AWS CUR 2.0, Amazon S3, and AWS Trusted Advisor form the data foundation that New Relic Cloud Cost Intelligence builds on for Amazon Bedrock workloads. The result is token-level cost visibility inside the observability workflows engineering teams already use, shifting AI from opaque experimentation to disciplined, ROI-driven operations.
items.creator: Swatika Gupta
